introHtml: Urban Peak duffle gym bags combine rugged waterproof construction with modern, streamlined design, making them a favorite for corporate wellness programs and team travel. The 41L Westlake and 47L Lakemont models offer spacious main compartments and multiple pockets, ideal for employees who commute or hit the gym. Customize with your logo using screen printing or embroidery for a crisp, durable finish that stands up to daily use.
